description: Judicial Service Commission Secretariat - Notify the Minute of the scheduled Public Officers' Service
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the Judicial Service Commission's authority over judicial appointments and service conditions for court officials (Registrars, Deputy Registrars, Court Management Assistants, etc.). It falls under Judicial/Law Enforcement (Type 9) as it deals with court administration, judicial service regulations, and appointments within the judicial system, specifically for Scheduled Public Officers in the judicial branch.
